name: Zealous Charge
notes: HoH1's Charge: a dash that deals 25-75 Physical damage (6 levels) and stuns for 0.5 s, 10-25 mana. HoH2's version stuns only with its Bull Rush orb. The levels here are HoH2's charge.sval.
summary: Charge forward, hitting every enemy in your path for Physical damage. Hold the key to charge it up for a faster, harder charge. This is HoH2's own unused Zealous Charge (players/paladin/skills/charge.sval), standing in for HoH1's Charge.
